dimensions.note: Carried over from the review of 2026.11.10.1; no non-test source changed but the version and the upgrades entry. The blanking is still pinned by unit tests that exist now: keyAuthorizations, acmeSecrets and seal in _helpers_test.ts, the HTTP-01 self-check text in no record or inventory line in _records_test.ts, and assertNoSecrets runs on the writes and logs of the list and get success tests of challenge, order, certificaterequest and issuer and of the trace test ('blanks the ACME values'). The three non-blocking points of the earlier review stand unchanged: (1) the shape finder misses a key authorization followed directly by a dot and a letter, preceded by a dot, cut short or broken by a line break, and the URL finder misses a percent-encoded path; (2) seal can blank an identity-adjacent field such as Challenge state when a hostile ACME server chooses a token or key equal to it; (3) README 'no ACME URL' holds for fields, not for a quoted message. None is new in this release.

Carried over from the review of 2026.11.10.1. git diff f96ba17 -- cert-manager shows no change to any non-test source but the version and the upgrades entry, so this verdict stands. Earlier note: Entry and completion at info with structured placeholders. The trace summary that is logged is built from sealed levels and sealed again; a unit test and smoke batch C look for the key authorization in it.

The bundled lib/cli.ts and lib/kubectl.ts changed in be98d11 (git diff f96ba17 -- ../lib): spawnProcess keeps at most maxOutputBytes of standard output and standard error together, stops a process that writes more as at its time limit (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after the grace, pipes let go) and marks the result tooLarge; tryCli sets the bound to 64 MiB when none is given and counts tooLarge as no success; cliError names it with kind too-large; lib/kubectl.ts throws KubectlError kind other, 'more than 67108864 bytes of output; kubectl was stopped'. now(), encodedName, assertDataName and appliesTo on cliCheck are new and not used by this extension. The rest of the lib diff is test files only (fakes and mutations.ts removed, test_inputs.ts added). Every kubectl call here goes through lib/kubectl.ts, so an output past the bound fails the method with KubectlError other before any write, which is what the README's new 'Output limit' section says ('fails with an error that says so'). The earlier notes stand: a deleted Certificate during the poll, a patch with no usable answer, a missing object told by kind; a run cancelled while the patch is out ends as a plain Error. Not blocking: the branch in lib/kubectl.ts that turns tooLarge into KubectlError other has no unit test of its own (lib/kubectl_test.ts does not mention it); lib/cli_test.ts covers the bound below it.

72 unit tests pass (deno task test), with fmt:check, lint and check clean. The strict fake is gone; stub_test.ts installs a stub spawn through __setSpawn and createModelTestContext, answers only the commands a test lists (an unlisted command rejects), and is put back by Symbol.dispose; every method test declares it with `using`, so the real spawn is restored even on failure. I read each method test: list and get of certificate, certificaterequest, order, challenge and issuer, trace and renew of certificate, each with a success test that asserts on the spec and data name of every record, on fields of the record and on the last log line, and a failure test that asserts the error and that nothing was written (refused list, missing object, not served CRD, refusal before kubectl runs). renew pins the patch body (the read resourceVersion, Issuing ManuallyTriggered) on standard input, the already-issuing refusal with one call and no patch, the Conflict answer and a refused patch. The README's new Testing text matches this. Lost with the fake, not blocking: no unit test runs renew with waitSeconds above 0 (the poll and the 'deleted' outcome), and none cancels a run; the poll is shown live by the smoke batches of 2026.11.10.1 only. Still open from the earlier review: no test holds the shapes the finder misses, and the stale resourceVersion refusal is shown for a stubbed Conflict only, as the README now says. No live suite was run for this release. That is the maintainer's decision and I record the reason rather than a defect: lib at be98d11 is already published and ran live inside @dataverket/renovate 2026.11.10.1 (release commit ef7f107 descends from be98d11); lib's own tests run real processes (40 pass, among them a process that prints without end, one that ignores SIGTERM after its output was cut, output up to the bound read whole, and runCli naming too-large); and no suite of this extension comes near 64 MiB. The live results in smoke/README.md are those of 2026.11.10.1, whose model code is the same.
